name: Reagan Brooks
description: Brand tokens for Reagan Brooks LLC, a privately held holding company in Richfield, Ohio.

antiqueBrass.use: Single accent — italics, callouts, key numerals

rules: Set everything in EB Garamond. Never substitute a sans-serif except for OS-rendered chrome.
Italic + Antique Brass is the one and only emphasis pattern.
Tracked uppercase 0.32em letter-spacing for all small labels.
Body text never smaller than 13px on web.

logo.wordmark: Stacked uppercase REAGAN / 12px horizontal rule / BROOKS · letter-spacing 0.28em · weight 500
logo.monogram: Ruled Square — RB in EB Garamond Medium 46pt centered inside a 1.6pt thin Slate Navy square frame, padded 14% from edge

voice.tone: Patient, plainspoken, exact. Confident without performance.
voice.boilerplate: Reagan Brooks is a privately held holding company headquartered in Northeast Ohio. The firm buys or creates businesses and actively operates a portfolio across consumer packaged goods, foodservice, asset resale and auctions, home services, real estate, athletics, and entertainment. Reagan Brooks invests with the long horizon of a family that intends to hold its assets across generations, and with the day-to-day discipline of an operator who has run the businesses inside it. The firm is named for the children of its founder.
